note: Both sets share the same core claims and the same two binding errors (the 3" dimension of the shower-pan/curb re-used as subfloor thickness, and the 3/4" MDF gable dimension re-used for the edge strip with a stitched quote). Set A additionally captures the substrate slope of 1/4" per foot, a real specification that Set B omits entirely, and also notes the subfloor. Set B instead disambiguates the two 1/2" gypsum wallboards and the 3/8" porcelain tile by attaching the correct detail (D3 vs D5) as conditions, which A leaves flat and partly duplicated. On balance A's extra correct engineering fact outweighs B's cleaner binding, though A carries more duplication and one trivial claim.
remarks: Shared errors suggest a common upstream extractor: the standalone '3"' dimension in D1 is bound twice (once as shower pan width, once as subfloor thickness) and the quote '3" SUBFLOOR FIN.' is stitched from three separate labels ('3"', 'SUBFLOOR', 'FIN. BATHROOM FLOOR'). Likewise '3/4" MDF EDGE STRIP' is not a contiguous string on the page; 3/4" MDF belongs to the gable while the edge strip is a separate unlabeled item. Both sets also state BLOCKING AS REQ'D twice (as shower pan support and as a floor-assembly layer). Neither set captures the LINE OF FIN. COUNTERTOP reference or the PT1 membrane turn-up/height notes.
